name: SunRay 3-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna 300SN Southport
description: Description The SunRay Southport 3-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna is constructed of Canadian hemlock wood for durability and a natural appearance. It includes a 4.5 kW Harvia electric heater with stones that produces heat up to 170°F. The included water bucket and ladle allow you to add steam for your desired humidity level. Standard features include a thermo-hygrometer, ergonomic seating, interior lighting, a sand timer, tempered glass, and an air ventilation system.
